documentation.content:
Any invocation of the `billingkillswitch` Cloud Run service means the project's $5 monthly cost cap fired (ADR-0013): the budget Pub/Sub topic delivered a cap-breach message and the kill-switch ran to detach billing. This is page-worthy - there is no benign rate for this metric.

Immediate actions:
1. Check the billing alert / budget notification in the SAME time window (Console -> Billing -> Budgets & alerts) to confirm the cap breach that triggered it.
2. Confirm whether billing was actually detached and which service drove the spend.
3. Follow the runbook: docs/runbooks/billing-killswitch.md (recovery + re-attach procedure).

Dashboard: 'Billing kill-switch invocations' widget in infra/monitoring/dashboard.json (docs/runbooks/observability.md section 1, series 4).
